annotations.title: Macro liquidity: Fed funds, 10y, balance sheet, RRP, stablecoin supply

description: Call this when the user asks about macro liquidity, the Fed balance sheet, reverse repo, rates or stablecoin supply in relation to crypto. Returns the recorded daily series and latest values. Without days, each series holds its newest 7 points; pass days for the daily series, and series for one key over a long window.

days.description: Window in days, 30-4000; the route clamps to that range. Omit for the newest 7 points of each series.

series.description: Optional. One series key from the answer's series field, e.g. fred_walcl_busd.

name: get_macro_liquidity
